name: Verify high-confidence classification populates Category and Subcategory
objective: Validate that when the AI has high confidence in classification, Category and Subcategory are auto-populated on the ticket.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon and describe a clear, specific issue
steps.testData: "I cannot connect to the corporate VPN from my laptop. Error: connection timeout."
steps.expectedResult: The assistant identifies this as a network/VPN issue with high confidence

steps.description: Complete the ticket creation flow and confirm
Open the created ticket record and check classification fields
steps.expectedResult: Category is populated (e.g., 'Network & Connectivity') and Subcategory is populated (e.g., 'VPN')
